math_notes.text: Revises the stratum-level axiom into an existence condition under X≪Y and a uniqueness condition for two compatible internal refinements. Two later axioms are interchanged by numbering and a drawn connector. For finite-type figures, the text drops the chosen family in favour of compatibility and describes the corresponding finite closed compatible subsets.

The current live AtM4(a) explicitly starts Si X≪Y. This supports S’s proposed refinement hypothesis as an intended formulation at the level of strata. The earlier page still literally writes X triangleleft F and must remain so. The current text has been revised from a least-member phrase to an inserted adjective read tentatively as minimal, plus compatible uniqueness; it is not a literal restatement of the earlier sentence.

For nonempty M the cancelled first universal statement fails when Phi is empty: choose M={a}, the closed-set family {empty,{a}}, and Phi=empty. Then Phi^a is empty and has no least element. This concerns only the abandoned universal draft, not the live axiom.

In the live selected family tilde Y^X={Z≤Y : X≪Z}, the hypothesis X≪Y guarantees nonemptiness: reflexivity gives Y≤Y, so Y itself belongs. This does not prove existence of a minimal member and does not settle the uncertain inserted adjective.

The finite-family reconstruction, the additional choice of infinite antifilters, and the final shadow-set representation are copied without an independent proof. No external pages named in the foot reference were consulted.

The semicolon in the AtM1/AtM3 range, the lower-case x inside Omb(x) with uppercase bound X, and the lower-case terminal index x remain literal. The marginal first primed letter is newly doubtful rather than repaired from the expected hereditary condition.
